title: Surreal Wanderer Portal
description: A large hooded figure composed of geometric patterns and multiple eyes stands on the left, its torso containing a circular portal revealing a lone traveler with a staff and rabbit-eared helmet on a red alien landscape under two moons. To the right, a second identical traveler walks along a winding path through a lavender field toward distant mountains, surrounded by floating masks, stars, and swirling cosmic motifs.
